### Overview

By [Sunday, August 30^th^]{style="color:#bb0000"},
you should ensure you can access the Ohio Supercomputer Center (OSC)
and the OSC Project for this course (`PAS3493`).

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
_If you have any questions about this or run into problems while setting up your OSC account,_
_contact Jelmer._
:::

### Why this is needed

Starting with next Monday's class, you will do nearly all of your
work for this course at OSC --- and to do so, you'll need an OSC account.

Earlier this week, you were added to the OSC Project for this course (`PAS3493`).
Membership in this project allows you to access the course's shared files
and to reserve computing resources.
If you didn't already have an OSC account,
being added to this project allows you to create one.

### What you should do

<hr style="height:1pt; visibility:hidden;" />

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### If you don't have an OSC account yet

1. You should have received an email from OSC (<no-reply@osc.edu>)
   informing you that you were added to OSC Project `PAS3493`,
   with a link to create an account.
   Follow the instructions in the email to create your account.

   ::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
   At some point during the course, you'll have to type your password in a
   terminal, where you won't be able to see what you are typing.
   We therefore recommend a password that is not extremely complicated or long.
   :::

2. Check that you can log in to OSC at <https://ondemand.osc.edu> using your
   OSC username and password (the login option on the left-hand side of the page).
   This typically works right away, but in some cases it _may_
   take up to half an hour after you create your account.

#### If you already have an OSC account

1. You should have received an email from OSC (<no-reply@osc.edu>)
   informing you that you were added to OSC Project `PAS3493`.
   Make sure you received this email --- other than that, you don't need to activate anything.

2. Check that you can log in to OSC at <https://ondemand.osc.edu> using your
   OSC username and password (the login option on the left-hand side of the page).

:::
